whatsapp.title: Connect WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Connect a WhatsApp Business number dedicated to this system to automatically send the payment slip link to the client (every time one is generated or reissued) and see received conversations, with the option to reply from here.
whatsapp.step1: Go to business.facebook.com → Business Settings → Users → System Users.
whatsapp.step2: Click Add, give it a name (e.g. "JHV Agrosystem") and set the role to Admin.
whatsapp.step3: Select the newly created system user → Add Assets → choose the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) → grant full control.
whatsapp.step4: Click Generate new token, select the app used for this integration, and check the permissions whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.
whatsapp.step5: Copy the generated token (it only appears once) and paste it into the Permanent Access Token field next to it.
whatsapp.step6: The Phone Number ID and the WABA ID are found in WhatsApp Manager → API Setup (they're codes, not the number itself or the account name). The WABA ID is required — it's what links the account to automatically routing received messages to the system.
